potential_advantage: Simple shunt protection concept; may be appropriate for a bounded transient envelope
key_tradeoffs_or_failure_modes: Clamp voltage/current, pulse energy, source impedance, fuse coordination, thermal behavior, and downstream absolute maximums must all be compatible
evidence_to_collect: Primary datasheets; pulse/thermal calculations; coordination review; test profile

potential_advantage: Can block reverse input; MOSFET approaches may reduce conduction loss
key_tradeoffs_or_failure_modes: Voltage drop/loss, surge/transient stress, reverse leakage, gate behavior, fault mode, and ratings vary by implementation
required_inputs_before_selection: Q-C01/Q-C02/Q-C03/Q-C06; current/load envelope; required reverse behavior
evidence_to_collect: Primary datasheets; worst-case loss/SOA calculations; startup/fault review

architecture_family: Active surge/overvoltage disconnect or clamp controller
potential_advantage: May provide controlled response to a defined overvoltage profile
key_tradeoffs_or_failure_modes: Controller limits, FET SOA, transient duration/energy, protection timing, latch/retry behavior, and layout are critical
required_inputs_before_selection: Q-C01/Q-C02/Q-C03/Q-C06/Q-C09; functional policy and source profile
evidence_to_collect: Controller/FET datasheets; transient and thermal calculations; fault test plan

potential_advantage: Can address conducted disturbance when integrated with a protection strategy
key_tradeoffs_or_failure_modes: Filter resonance, inrush, damping, conducted emissions, component pulse ratings, and interaction with source/load
evidence_to_collect: Filter/protection model and datasheets; damping analysis; measurement plan

architecture_family: Central suppression assumed at system level
potential_advantage: May reduce local board stress if system-level behavior is guaranteed
key_tradeoffs_or_failure_modes: Cannot be assumed from a vehicle/industrial label; board exposure, wiring inductance, fault state, and customer configuration may differ
required_inputs_before_selection: Q-C02 and system-level source/installation evidence; Q-C01/Q-C03/Q-C09
evidence_to_collect: Customer/system specification and installation constraints; board-level residual stress analysis

potential_advantage: Avoids applying an irrelevant automotive pulse envelope if scope is formally industrial
key_tradeoffs_or_failure_modes: Does not remove industrial surge/EFT, reverse-polarity, wiring, or transient requirements; domain must be approved
required_inputs_before_selection: CF-08; Q-C01/Q-C02/Q-C03/Q-C09 and approved functional class
evidence_to_collect: Approved product-domain decision and applicable standards/OEM profile
